mapper.select: SELECT ei.id, ei.asset_id, ei.rated_weight, ei.basic_height, ei.ascending_speed, ei.rated_load, ei.cabin_size, ei.max_ascending_height, eq.asset_name, eq.asset_code, loc.location_name FROM equipment_assets eq INNER JOIN elevator_info ei ON ei.asset_id = eq.asset_id LEFT JOIN equipment_location loc ON eq.location_id = loc.location_id WHERE eq.type_id = #{typeId}
